'''Sinker''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A member of the [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]], he was under the command of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] . He was stationed on the [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']] when the ship and two other [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] chased [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' ''secret weapon'' to [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado]]. The [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] destroyed all three ships, but Sinker, along with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Plo Koon, [[Boost/Legends|Boost]] and [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] managed to escape via an escape pod. They were attacked in their escape pod by battle droids but were able to defeat them, thanks to Koon's skills. Koon was able to reach Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was along with her master on a rescue mission for the battle survivors. Skywalker and Tano were able to rescue the pod and escape the ''Malevolence''. Sinker would later serve under Koon in many missions.

==Biography==
===Malevolence===
{{Quote|Don't look at me. It's Boost, sir. He only takes a bath when he's on leave.|Sinker to Plo Koon and Wolffe|<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Sinker-TCW.png|thumb|left|180px|Sinker in his Wolfpack armor]]
When [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] was dispatched to search for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] "mystery weapon" in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> which has destroyed several Republic fleets, Sinker was part of Plo Koon's troops. Upon discovering the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], the ''Malevolence'' fired with her ion cannons on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class cruiser]] which rendered them without energy. Then the many cannons of the Subjugator-cruiser began to fire, quickly destroying the three ships. Sinker escaped from the [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']] in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], [[Boost/Legends|Boost]] and Master Plo Koon.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

After discovering another escape pod with its hatch cut right open, Plo Koon and the clones then picked up a signal from [[Pod 1977/Legends|Pod 1977]]. However, the [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|pod hunters]] arrived and destroyed it, and then proceeded to attack Plo Koon's pod. Plo Koon, Boost and Sinker exited the pod to confront the [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]], and they succeeded, especially after Plo Koon used [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] Sinker past the pod hunter ship and destroy the battle droids. The four were then rescued by [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] aboard the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]. However, while [[TB-2/Legends|TB-2]] was treating the injured clones, the lights went out, and the medical droid went to the bridge to find out what was wrong. In reality, the ''Twilight'' had stumbled upon the ''Malevolence'', and Anakin, Ahsoka and Plo Koon shut down all power to avoid detection, but they had forgotten to turn off the medical droid. Fortunately, the ''Twilight'' was able to escape a wave from the ion cannons.<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

===Khorm===
{{Quote|Sinker, get the men into the gunships.|Wolffe to Sinker, during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]]|<ref name="ISotR">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>}}
[[File:BoostSinkerKhorm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sinker and Boost on [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].]]
Sinker, Boost and Commander Wolffe were among the Republic forces dispatched to the Separatist-occupied world of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] to secure the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]], which could be used to increase power to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Led by Jedi Generals Plo Koon and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], as well as [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], the Republic successfully captured an [[Agrocite processing facility]], but it was soon recaptured by the Confederacy. Later, as Koon and Fisto were scouting out the main Separatist stronghold located in an Agrocite [[Mining/Legends|mine]], Major Ozzel and his troops returned to regain control of the processing facility, only to find it abandoned by the Confederate forces.<ref name="ISotR" />

Ozzel then assumed that the enemy was on the brink of defeat and ordered to move his troops to the Agrocite mine to assist the Jedi in its capture. Sinker and Boost, however, did not share the major's optimism and told Commander Wolffe that the Separatists had apparently abandoned the facility for a reason and were not intent on giving up the mine easily. Wolffe replied that the clones had their orders and told Sinker to get the clone troopers into the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]]. As Sinker and Boost had predicted, the Separatists offered heavy resistance during the assault on the mine, but nevertheless, the Republic managed to win the battle.<ref name="ISotR" />

===Felucia===
Sinker also served alongside the Wolfpack when they were trying to recapture [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Sinker, along with Boost and [[Comet (clone trooper)/Legends|Comet]], went with Ahsoka to jump onto the wall of a Separatist base. Shortly after the battle, they discovered that Ahsoka had gone missing.<ref name="TCW-PL">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref>

===Aleen===
Sinker, with Boost and the rest of Wolfpack, went to [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] to provide care for the native [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]]. They went along with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and hooked up the power systems.

===Kadavo===
Sinker was sent to the [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] system to rescue Anakin Skywalker, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] from [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Sinker, along with Comet and Wolffe, used [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to rescue [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutas]] from their prison cells.

==Equipment==
Sinker wielded a DC-15 blaster like most clones at that time. His Phase I armor bore the markings of the Wolfpack.

==Personality and traits==
As a Human clone trooper, Sinker stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. A loyal trooper, Sinker cooperated with the other members of the Wolfpack such as Boost, Wolf and the squad leader, Plo Koon.

Sinker believed that he, and all other clones, were expendable to the Republic's cause, though Plo Koon assured him otherwise.
